title: Modal with Focus Trap
prompt:
You are a web developer. Complete the following task.

TASK: Build a React functional component called `Modal` that takes props `isOpen`, `onClose`, `title`, and `children`. When open, render a backdrop overlay and a centered modal dialog. Clicking the backdrop calls `onClose`. Pressing Escape calls `onClose`. Implement a focus trap so the first focusable element receives focus on open and Tab cycles through focusable elements within the modal only. Add a close button (×) in the top-right. Add `role="dialog"` and `aria-modal="true"` to the dialog element.

CONSTRAINTS:
- Functional component with `useEffect`, `useRef`
- Default export
- Props: `isOpen`, `onClose`, `title`, `children`
- Backdrop click closes modal
- Escape key closes modal
- Focus trap within modal
- Close button (×) in top-right
- `role="dialog"` and `aria-modal="true"`
- First focusable element receives focus on open

IMPORTANT:
- Return ONLY the code. No explanations.
- Output a single complete file.
- Do not use markdown code blocks.
constraints: First focusable element receives focus on open
